AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation *is* construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (entomancer.py:31-33). SHARED-FINDINGS section 2's shared verdict, copied: the game runs these from MonsterModel.AfterAddedToRoom via CombatManager.AfterCreatureAdded (CombatManager.cs:860-867) inside StartCombatInternal (CombatManager.cs:394-398), i.e. after every creature is on the board and before Hook.BeforeCombatStart (CombatManager.cs:403); the sim runs them at create_monsters (combat.py:134), before relics attach (combat.py:157-159), before belt potions register (combat.py:164-166), before the parity Niche HP roll (combat.py:152-153) and before hooks.on_combat_start (combat.py:208). Same observable today on all three of section 2's clauses (listener set / HP-roll inversion / roll ordering); executed for this unit by `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b05.py rocket-ctor`, which prints the listener set at monster-construction time for a two-monster hive encounter: ['CombatHistory','StrikeCard','DefendCard', the previously-created monster's own powers] - no relic, no potion. Rule 7: the rationale leans on sts2_rl/combat.py, sts2_rl/relics/ruined_helmet.py, sts2_rl/relics/unsettling_lamp.py and src/Core/Combat/CombatManager.cs, which this record does NOT hash. Amount matches: Entomancer.cs:38 applies PersonalHivePower 1m to itself.

GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: Three-node fixed cycle, no branch state. C# (Entomancer.cs:41-53): BEES_MOVE (MultiAttackIntent(3, 7)) -> SPEAR_MOVE (SingleAttackIntent(18)) -> PHEROMONE_SPIT_MOVE (BuffIntent) -> BEES_MOVE, registered [SPIT, BEES, SPEAR], initialState = BEES. The sim wires the identical follow-up ring, the identical registration order and the same initial state.

guards.what: SpitMove's PersonalHive lookup: C# .First() vs sim .get()
guards.rationale: Entomancer.cs:59 does Powers.OfType<PersonalHivePower>().First(), which THROWS if the power is gone; entomancer.py:52-57 uses powers.get('personal_hive') and falls into the >=3 arm (+2 Strength) when it is None. The two differ only if the hive can be removed. Executed - `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b05.py entomancer-hive` greps every sts2_rl reference to 'personal_hive': the only sites are powers.py:2375 (the class) and entomancer.py:33/52-54 (apply + read). No sim effect removes it, and PersonalHivePower has no expiry, so the divergent arm is unreachable. Rule 7: that argument leans on sts2_rl/powers.py, unhashed.
Entomancer.cs:60-68: hive.Amount < 3 -> PersonalHive +1 and Strength +1, else Strength +2. Sim entomancer.py:53-57 is the same threshold, the same two applications and the same order (_MAX_HIVE = 3).
EntomancerElite.cs:13-16 generates a single Entomancer with a null slot; ENTOMANCER_ELITE (entomancer.py:66-69) is monster_classes=[Entomancer].
